packageRules.description: specta and specta-typescript are pinned to exact release candidates (apps/tauri/src-tauri/Cargo.toml) for the sync frontend-contract test, which exports u64 fields as TS numbers to match Tauri's wire shape. rc.27 and later refuse to export u64. They move together, by hand.

Filament must match scripts/coin-ibl-pin.json: a cubemap baked by a different Filament's cmgen renders the supporter coin with wrong lighting instead of failing. Bump both with scripts/build-coin-ibl.mjs --refresh.
